decision: Keep the hashed offline qualification support bundle immutable by copying its npm cache into each disposable install prefix and deleting that working copy after npm exits.
implemented_capabilities: per-install npm cache isolation for offline product qualification
post-install verification that the artifact and support bundle still match their manifests
cleanup of the disposable cache on both successful and failed npm execution
architectural_invariants: the support bundle remains a read-only, exact-set qualification input
offline installation still uses only dependencies bound into the prepared support bundle
cache isolation does not advance maturity or release authority
